in_marathi.name: Mukes
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the face or deity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mukes हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Mukes is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mukha’, meaning face or deity. This name is believed to represent the one who is the lord of the face or the embodiment of a deity. It is a powerful and spiritual name that is often given to boys in Hindu communities.
